propositions: BindingStore.set_baseline unconditionally wrote baseline_advanced_at timestamp with no production reader, causing pathological git delta churn across baseline changes that did not alter actual entry values
The write-when-changed guard filters mirrored fields, compares equality with stored baseline, and returns early without reading clock or writing baseline_advanced_at when values are unchanged
Consecutive reconciler passes over unchanged Jira state must produce byte-identical bindings.json and preserve tracker HEAD without new commits
Present-but-null baseline fields must round-trip through serialization as present, and baseline value changes must persist and update serialized bytes
Packed-cost measurement over 40-SHA historical corpus shows marginal cost reduced from 13.84 KiB/version to 2.33 KiB/version (16.8% of baseline, below 25% gate)
